# RogueIQ

> RogueIQ (rogueiq.com) builds simple tools from public data. Tools run in the browser; user inputs are not sent or stored. Educational only, not financial advice.

## Tools

- [Net Worth by Age Checker](https://rogueiq.com/networth-by-age/): See how your net worth compares with US families your age. Federal Reserve 2025 survey data.
- Primary-source finance news feed (status: Building, not yet available): Finance news traced to the original report, for creators and their AI agents.

## Blog

- [Blog index](https://rogueiq.com/blog/)
- [RSS feed](https://rogueiq.com/blog/rss.xml)

## Build log

- 2026-10-19: Started building a primary-source finance news feed for creators and AI agents.
- 2026-10-17: Launched the Net Worth by Age Checker (Fed SCF 2025 data, six filters).
